headline: 1-2' and almost unsurfable — do your chores, walk your dog.

headline: Cocoa Beach 2'+ clean lines but sandbars are shot. Longboard lines falling into troughs.
text: 1 PM lowtide update from Cocoa Beach's best surf spot — 2 foot plus with light winds and clean lines, but our sandbars are shot. A solid longboard line would hit the outside sandbar before immediately falling into a trough. The inside was closing out on lowtide. Water is warm though. Sandbars need some reshaping before we get the goods.
